name: Strother
description: A mercenary who, with Borg and Elam, hunts a serpent generator.

description_citations.text: "The Monsters of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of the Pit eats the orc warlord, his sergeant and the serpent generator, and the mercenaries flee.
timeline.quote: the Lord of the Pit returns from battle just then and eats the warlord and his sergeant as his tribute.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Unlikely Allies and Unjust Desserts , by Brian M. Thomsen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Strother, Borg and Elam flood Cometia with snakes from a serpent generator, killing many defenders.
timeline.quote: They flooded Cometia with snakes, killing many of its defenders

citation.text: "Strother, Borg and Elam", section "Cometia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Snap goes into the generator, destroying it and saving Cometia; the trio is reassigned to the zombie slough.
timeline.quote: Snap went into the crack and then into the generator, destroying it and saving Cometia

citation.text: "Strother, Borg and Elam", section "Cometia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Working for Lord Ugliness, the trio finds the Serpent Generator made by Mutter Makree.
timeline.quote: they found the Serpent Generator made by Mutter Makree

citation.text: "Strother, Borg and Elam", section "The Lord of the Pit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Lord of the Pit demands tribute; the trio feed it snakes and it collects zombie scalps for them.
timeline.quote: The trio fed snakes to the demon

citation.text: "Strother, Borg and Elam", section "The Lord of the Pit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The trio redirect the demon to the next day's banquet and flee.
timeline.quote: they redirected the demon to the banquet feast that would be held the next day

citation.text: "Strother, Borg and Elam", section "The Lord of the Pit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A lazy, hungry, smelly dwarf soldier on Shiv.
